source_text.body:
Run a small business's recurring workflows with scheduled agent tasks
The author moved a small-business setup with instructions, custom skills and over a dozen scheduled tasks from local Cowork sessions to Claude Code cloud sessions.
·
Oct 1, 2026
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The author rebuilt a desktop Claude workflow for two small businesses, consulting, and nonprofit admin work into Claude Code cloud sessions. They put instructions and recipes in a private GitHub repo cloned into every session, moved API keys into Claude cloud environment network secrets, moved working files to Google Drive, and recreated 12-plus scheduled tasks as routines that read a recipe and execute it; Claude proposed the migration plan, but setup and credential entry were manual.
How it went
Remote sessions now have the same context, instructions, and credentials across phone, laptop, and desktop, and the scheduled-task migration worked. Pain points were weaker routine permissions, clunky cloud file editing especially for XLSX files, and some local-only work like image or video tasks.
Worth knowing
The migration and planning used three 5-hour sessions on a Max 5x plan, and the author said they lost about a day to the change.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
I run [type of small business] and want to move my recurring workflows into cloud sessions with scheduled tasks. Set up a project with instructions describing my business, then create a skill and a schedule for each of these jobs: [list of recurring tasks and how often]. When finished, show me the list of scheduled tasks with their timing, and pause for my approval before any task that sends messages, spends money, or deletes anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1wux3tb/i_moved_my_small_business_claude_setup_from_local
